posts.title: WistThistle | Do you like it?
posts.description: These are three poems recited by a stowaway (a lost girl) to a visiting rat in the fifth book of the six novel WistThistle Cycle. After reciting each poem, she asks the rat: “Do you like it?” I had planned to be done with the fifth book by now, The Silent Sea, but summer intervened. […]
